Doing it all in one go

walkthroughs.body_html:
Learning is a change in what you can do because of experience.

Tying your shoes, riding a bike, French verbs — all learning.

Skill grows from practice.

Even better with feedback — knowing what you got wrong.

10 hours of bad practice doesn't beat 1 hour of corrected practice. 🎯

Research-backed methods:

  • Active recall — try to answer from memory.
  • Spaced practice — short sessions, many days.
  • Mixing topics.

Cramming the night before? Hard for your brain. 😴
